capabilities: Render task wikilinks as interactive widgets with checkbox, title, project, area and dates
Toggle a task between ready and done from the widget checkbox
Convert a checklist item into a Taskdn task file via right-click
Show the title frontmatter as the inline title of task files
Rename task files to kebab-case to match the edited title
extras: Needs Obsidian 1.13 or later, wikilinks enabled, and a tasks folder of files following the Taskdn spec; ignored-file patterns support a * wildcard.
problem: Links to task files kept as Markdown with YAML frontmatter are plain text in notes, so status is invisible and tasks cannot be completed from the note.

relations.evidence: adds a button to open tasks in the Taskdn desktop app

summary: Renders wikilinks to Taskdn task files as interactive checklist widgets and converts checklist items into task files.
